rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:1.2: can: The header (p408-strip0.jpg) prints 8.7.8.7.D.; stanza 1's line 2 on system 1 sings 7 syllables to the capitalised moved word, and line 3 on system 2 (p408-strip800.jpg) sings 8. Moving the word down makes them 6 and 9, which breaks the metre.
